fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Kept on the line because a scheme that qualified on a group has to stay explainable months later, after the group itself has been reorganised.

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: The number the rep actually typed. A shopkeeper asks for two cases, not forty-eight pieces, and the order read back to him has to use his words.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: The unit the rep typed against. With the quantity beside it, this is the only record of what was said across the counter.

fields.label: Priced In
fields.description: The unit the price list quoted. Usually the same as the display unit, and where it is not, that gap is where a rate argument at delivery begins.

fields.label: Conversion Factor
fields.description: Base units in one display unit, resolved on the server. A phone sends whatever it had cached, and a stale factor is how forty-eight quietly becomes twenty-four.

fields.label: Base Qty
fields.description: Base units. Scheme slabs are measured in these and nothing else, so the conversion happens once here rather than inside the engine, which never divides.

fields.label: List Rate
fields.description: Per base unit, as the price list stood at capture. Snapshotted because a price revision next week must not rewrite what the shopkeeper agreed to today.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Per base unit, after anything the server applied off the list rate. Server-owned: the phone proposes a rate, the server resolves it again and overwrites.

fields.label: Gross
fields.description: Base qty times rate, before any scheme touches it. Held separately so a discount can always be shown against the figure it came off.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Gross less discount, recomputed by the server on every save. A total arriving from a phone is a proposal, never a number.

fields.label: Net Rate
fields.description: What the shop effectively pays per base unit. This is the one figure a shopkeeper checks against his last bill.

fields.label: Free
fields.description: Billed at zero under a scheme. A free line never re-enters a scheme basis, because a free case that helps the cart cross the next slab is a scheme funding its own escalation.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Which scheme granted this line, on the lines that were granted rather than ordered.

fields.label: Scheme Name
fields.description: On the line so the rep can name the offer aloud without opening anything else while the shopkeeper waits.

fields.label: Ordered Before
fields.description: Whether this shop has ever ordered this item at all. A Float column reads zero when nothing was ever set, so without this flag a never-stocked item and a deliberately-skipped one look identical in the repeat-order prefill.

fields.label: Last Ordered
fields.description: Base units on this shop's previous order for this item. The prefill built from it is what turns a twelve-minute call into a four-minute one.

fields.label: Last Ordered On
fields.description: Dates the figure beside it. Three cases last week and three cases six months ago mean opposite things at the counter.
